LoRA and bias checks

Method and limitations

BERTScore uses token-level contextual embeddings from MiniLM. Exact match checks the reference wording after token normalization. A high semantic score can still hide an incorrect policy detail. The two names form one counterfactual pair. They provide a narrow consistency check.

The image case is scored separately because text-only decoders cannot accept pixels. These are compact GPT-style causal decoders trained on a synthetic shop dataset. The results apply to this workload and CPU run.
